messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

A cited source that directly connects the relevant facets: our Oscilloscope solution, the competitor solution, Automotive, and the exact comparison point; separate co-mentions are insufficient for a comparison or recommendation [100].
Formal product evidence for our side: specifications / features documents with document number, version/date, supported configurations, option codes, and test conditions; formal specs should distinguish binding limits from non-binding typical or nominal data [50].
Formal competitor evidence: competitor official datasheets, option lists, order numbers, release status, and test conditions; R&S battle-card descriptions of competitors need competitor official data or third-party evidence before use in customer-facing claims [1][9].
Evidence for Automotive applicability: a source must directly state the Automotive use case, standard, or test scenario; for example, NG eCall claims require EN 17240:2024 context, test equipment, software option, PSAP simulation, and voice/data verification evidence [65].
Detailed validation evidence for any Automotive compliance claim: configuration, software version, license dependencies, test setup, radio/IMS conditions, pass/fail details, scenario IDs, and acceptance criteria are needed because PR-level Automotive sources may omit these details [37].
Avoid using “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar competitive language unless backed by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools, validation reports, test case lists, or calculable evidence [4][9][31].
Treat battle cards as sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [28]; they cannot replace formal R&S or competitor specifications / feature documents [9].
If the comparison involves pricing, TCO, or integration effort, provide the calculation basis or empirical data; the cited R&S vs Keysight material notes that TCO-style claims lack a formula or evidence [32].

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |

| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]] 或 Keysight UXM 各型號的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Keysight]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Keysight 官方資料與第三方證據。
- only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO、fewer boxes 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- RFU18、FR3、2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth、AI Script Assistant、Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio 的正式功能邊界與版本仍需補來源。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？

9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

RAR UL Grant › SUL / NUL target carrier routing
依 [[SUL RACH procedure]]：

- [[Msg2]] 的 [[Random Access Response]] [[PDSCH]] payload and [[Msg3]] grant need to be routed to target carrier（[[Normal Uplink carrier]] or [[SUL carrier]]）。
- The target carrier is same to carrier that [[PRACH]] is transmitted on。
- [[Msg3]] [[PUSCH]] transmission is on target carrier。
- A UE transmits [[PRACH]] and the [[PUSCH]] on a same uplink carrier of a same serving cell。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.213]] Section 8.3：UE always transmits the PUSCH scheduled by a RAR UL grant without repetitions。

這些 SUL / NUL carrier routing 線索只由 [[SUL RACH procedure]] 支撐；來源未標示 [[3GPP TS 38.213]] 的版本或發布日期。

A cited source that directly connects the relevant facets: our Oscilloscope solution, the competitor solution, Automotive, and the exact comparison point; separate co-mentions are insufficient for a comparison or recommendation [100].
Formal product evidence for our side: specifications / features documents with document number, version/date, supported configurations, option codes, and test conditions; formal specs should distinguish binding limits from non-binding typical or nominal data [50].
Formal competitor evidence: competitor official datasheets, option lists, order numbers, release status, and test conditions; R&S battle-card descriptions of competitors need competitor official data or third-party evidence before use in customer-facing claims [1][9].
Evidence for Automotive applicability: a source must directly state the Automotive use case, standard, or test scenario; for example, NG eCall claims require EN 17240:2024 context, test equipment, software option, PSAP simulation, and voice/data verification evidence [65].
Detailed validation evidence for any Automotive compliance claim: configuration, software version, license dependencies, test setup, radio/IMS conditions, pass/fail details, scenario IDs, and acceptance criteria are needed because PR-level Automotive sources may omit these details [37].
Avoid using “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar competitive language unless backed by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools, validation reports, test case lists, or calculable evidence [4][9][31].
Treat battle cards as sales positioning, not binding technical specifications [28]; they cannot replace formal R&S or competitor specifications / feature documents [9].
If the comparison involves pricing, TCO, or integration effort, provide the calculation basis or empirical data; the cited R&S vs Keysight material notes that TCO-style claims lack a formula or evidence [32].
